name: Add shadcn/ui to an existing project
steps: Review generated components and accessibility.
Run the app's typecheck, lint and tests.

name: Next.js app
steps: Choose TypeScript, linting and app structure in the upstream prompts.
Add shadcn with set-my-vibe project shadcn --cwd <project> --run.

name: Better-T-Stack interactive stack builder
steps: Choose frontend, backend, auth, database and deployment target in the upstream prompts.
Review the generated bts.jsonc and follow the generator's README.

name: Cloudflare Workers app
steps: Run wrangler login locally.
Choose Workers-compatible libraries and configure bindings for D1, R2, KV, queues or Hyperdrive as needed.
Use wrangler secret put for production secrets. Keep local .dev.vars ignored.
Test locally and on a preview environment before explicitly deploying. This recipe disables initial deployment.

name: Better-T-Stack with Neon setup guide
steps: Choose PostgreSQL and a compatible ORM in Better-T-Stack; select Neon if offered by the current generator.
Run neon login. Choose region and organization before explicitly creating or linking a database.
Keep DATABASE_URL in your local secret store. Use pooled connections where appropriate and a direct URL for migrations if your ORM requires it.
Use isolated development/preview branches, a least-privilege runtime role, migrations, and a tested restore procedure.

name: Better-T-Stack with Upstash setup guide
steps: Generate the app with Better-T-Stack; this wrapper does not inject Upstash application code.
Explicitly create or select a Redis/QStash resource in the intended region and account.
Install the appropriate Upstash SDK in the generated app. Keep service tokens server-side.
Verify tenant-aware rate limits, TTLs, retry/backoff, signed QStash callbacks and replay/idempotency behavior where used.

name: Expo mobile app
steps: Select compatible Expo SDK packages; run the generated app on a real device or simulator.
Configure EAS build profiles, signing, permissions, privacy declarations and update channels.
Test offline behavior, deep links and permission-denied paths before store submission.
